theorems.name: Submission.adr_uniform_bound_of_weak_bounded
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (gs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid Q) (K : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ k, LocallyIntegrable (gs k) μ) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → ∃ C, ∀ k, ‖∫ x, f x • gs k x ∂μ‖ ≤ C) → IsCompact K → ∃ M, ∀ (k : ℕ) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (C : ℝ), Continuous h → (∀ x ∉ K, h x = 0) → (∀ x, |h x| ≤ C) → ‖∫ x, h x • gs k x ∂μ‖ ≤ M * C
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
